limitations: No effective stabilization threshold or simplified full density in the case of multiple shared pair gcds. A generic earlier coefficient algorithm could indirectly imply formula after analysis; priority is subject to human bibliographic review.
scientific_integrity: Infinite claims are supported by a rational-generating-function and CRT proof; finite integer checks are supplemental, not independent validation.
title: A coprimality dichotomy and exact descent densities for three-generator denumerants
